decisions.reason: The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY capturing the LDO source, activation condition, rating, powered scope, and standalone-programming behavior. The Schottky OR-ing mechanism remains independently owned by the source Requirement.
The OR-ing decision concerns selection between 3.3V sources and does not change the candidate's GPIO3-controlled 5V supply behavior for the SK6812 LEDs.
The candidate already records the same message's 5V boost rating and powered loads. Selection between the AXP2101 and main-board LDO for the 3.3V rail does not alter boost-enable behavior.
Identifying AXP2101 DCDC1 as the normal-operation power source does not resolve or modify the candidate's VMID-to-VSYS topology requirements.
The source discusses USB-C power on the main board, not the power-board USB connector's data-line, connector-selection, or sourceability requirements.
The operating-mode power mapping does not change the interboard connector types, signals, pin-order policy, or unresolved physical numbering.
Powering I2C sensors from the selected 3.3V source does not change the I2C clock, cable length, pull-up configuration, or series-resistor policy.
The source-selection decision does not change the battery-charge indicator, CHGLED connector, resistor values, or component-population rules.
The statement that the battery feeds AXP2101 is descriptive of upstream power flow and does not determine the unresolved battery pinout or alter the connector's placement, form, or signals.
The electrical source-selection behavior has no necessary effect on board dimensions, mounting holes, connector placement, or enclosure fit.
The power mapping does not change the battery NTC sensing method or its connection through J_BAT.
The battery-to-AXP2101 power-flow description does not modify the established overcharge, overdischarge, or thermal-protection requirements.
